Groww is one of the best investing apps with a clean interface, easy SIP setup, and smooth mutual fund and stock investing experience. I've been using it regularly and am very satisfied with the platform.

One feature I would love to see is support for a dual-app or multiple-account option. Many users manage separate investments for different family members or purposes, and having the ability to use two Groww accounts on the same device would make the experience much more convenient.

Overall, an excellent app with a user-friendly design. Hoping the Groww team considers adding dual-account support in a future update.
